reason: Fabric is a plugin-development runtime that provides a declarative DSL, service API, model tools, and inspection UI for registering, querying, composing, and removing DSH extensions; the README states it has no file persistence or credential handling but supports executable extensions and a read-only census route.

summaries.zh: Fabric 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一的声明式 DSL、服务 API 和模型工具，用于注册、查询、组合与移除运行时插件扩展。
summaries.en: Fabric provides DeepSeek Harness with a declarative DSL, service API, and model tools for registering, inspecting, composing, and removing runtime plugin extensions.

capabilities: Registers and manages runtime extensions through a declarative DSL and Fabric service
Allows plugin code to register executable tools, commands, event listeners, adapters, providers, routes, and other extension types
Allows model-facing tools to add non-executable prompt, skill, and variable declarations
Exposes runtime extension metadata through inspection tools and a read-only census route
